description: This Java class, LoansPointInTimeApiDelegate, implements the LoansPointInTimeApi interface and provides endpoints for retrieving loan data at specific points in time, supporting both internal loan IDs and external IDs, with permission checks and date handling.

classes.name: LoansPointInTimeApiDelegate
classes.description: A delegate class that implements the LoanPointInTime API endpoints for fetching loan snapshot data at specific points in time, ensuring proper permissions and handling both internal and external loan identifiers.

methods.name: retrieveLoanPointInTime
methods.description: Retrieves loan data for a specific loan ID at a given date, ensuring user has read permissions.

methods.name: retrieveLoanPointInTimeByExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves loan data using an external ID, resolving it to internal ID before fetching data.

methods.name: retrieveLoansPointInTime
methods.description: Retrieves multiple loans' data at a specified date based on a list of loan IDs.

methods.name: retrieveLoansPointInTimeByExternalIds
methods.description: Retrieves multiple loans' data at a specified date using a list of external IDs.

methods.name: getLoansPointInTime
methods.description: Helper method to fetch loan data for a list of IDs at a specific date.

methods.name: getLoanPointInTime
methods.description: Helper method to fetch a single loan's data at a specific date.

methods.name: resolveExternalIds
methods.description: Resolves external IDs to internal loan IDs, throwing exception if IDs are invalid.
